comments:
The work is different from (ID:6860), an untitled work the incipit of which suggests a similar title as the present one.

This may correspond to the work  listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 514, No. 11066: gtsang nag pa'i (bslab btus dang) spyod 'jug (gnyis) kyi 'grel pa).

The author refers to the views of other Tibetan scholars, some of whom are identified in glosses in (ID:4558), notably rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) ex013052025-11-2711-02-54, ex013052025-11-2711-06-32 , Ar Byang chub ye shes (ID:3816) ex013052025-11-2711-10-15 , rGya dmar ba (ID:3834) ex013052025-11-2711-18-04 , possibly Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) ex0130152025-11-2711-08-09 .
